data.one_liner: A customizable onboarding and tour guide kit for Flutter with spotlight overlays and tooltips.
data.what_it_does: Provides an onboarding and product tour kit for Flutter applications. It highlights widgets with dark spotlight overlays, displays animated tooltips, and supports step-by-step navigation, keyboard controls, and multiple shapes and animations.
use_when: You need to build a product tour or walkthrough for first-time app users.
You want to highlight specific UI elements with spotlight overlays and tooltips.
avoid_when: You need complex state management solutions.
You are building a backend or database-driven feature.
strengths: Includes 8 animation types and multiple highlight shapes like circles, pills, and rounded rectangles.
Supports keyboard navigation and smart tooltip positioning to avoid screen edges.
weaknesses: Relies on GlobalKeys attached to currently visible widgets for targeting.
Limited to onboarding and UI walkthrough use cases.
